source: Local time-class gates -- affected by machine load / compiler / background processes; not in CI, only for local trend comparison.
note: Time-class gates are not in CTest. Counter-class G-5~G-8 are locked into CTest by tests/unit/utest_scroll.cpp (case scroll_regression_counter_gates), which reads these thresholds by gate id -- a missing entry fails the case instead of silently asserting nothing. Those four gates need AURORA_ENABLE_PROFILING=ON (otherwise RenderCounters is compiled out and the case registers as a skip stub); CI job profiling-tracing-debug-on runs them. Readings are per-frame maxima over 60 sampled frames of a fixed deterministic scene: Scroll(300x200 viewport) wrapping a Column of 40 plain 300x40 FixedBox rows. G-8 tracks dirty_rect_count, NOT dirty_area_ratio: a scrolling frame legitimately dirties the whole viewport, so the ratio sits at exactly 1.0 on every frame and any threshold there is either vacuous or always red.
